goal: Convert the Phase154-163 evidence architecture into an executable real-device capture queue while keeping planned work separate from real evidence.

campaign_tracks.note: Uses only the dated Phase145/153 GSC-supported au eSIM query cluster; no fresh uplift/demand claim.
Extends the only existing SolQvia-owned device evidence without merging Y!mobile and SoftBank scopes.
Prioritized by current evidence-gap closure and implementation readiness, not by unverified device-level search demand.

current_real_device_evidence.reason: Phase164 creates execution plans only. Real-device evidence can be added only after a test is actually performed and passes Phase162 privacy/evidence validation.

priority_logic: Use explicit GSC demand only when a supported query cluster exists.
Prefer deepening an existing SolQvia capture before starting equivalent evidence from zero.
Prefer models with Phase159/163 scaffolding when an exact runtime capture would close multiple high-value gaps.
Higher execution cost, such as a four-carrier matrix, is preserved as a cost/availability constraint rather than ignored.
Device availability is unknown until the tester confirms the actual device/line can be used.
execution_flow: Generate a blank Phase162-compatible capture template.
Fill exact device/carrier/SIM/software context before testing.
Project to Phase161 diagnosis when useful.
Only then update Phase163 Device Passport deep overlay.
next_gate: Actual real-device execution. Do not advance a planned campaign into Phase162/Phase163 until observed results are supplied or captured.
